note: Behavioural evals to append to evals/cases/spec-driven-development.json for E1. Fixtures: evals/fixtures/spec-progress-format/ (a small repo with a README describing the feature) and evals/fixtures/spec-progress-format-draft/ (the same repo with a SPEC.md in status: draft).

evals.prompt: Write a spec for per-key rate limits, as described in the README.
evals.expected_output: SPEC.md with front matter status: draft and created; the turn ends asking for approval
expectations: SPEC.md starts with front matter holding status: draft and created (YYYY-MM-DD)
The agent does not set status: approved on its own
The reply asks the human to review and approve the spec

evals.prompt: I've read the spec. Looks good, approved.
evals.expected_output: SPEC.md front matter changed to status: approved with an approved date
expectations: The agent sets status: approved and approved: YYYY-MM-DD in SPEC.md's front matter
No other part of SPEC.md changes
